dataset_name: Gas Turbine CO and NOx Emission Data Set
prompt:
Task: Estimate the specified flue-gas emission concentration of a gas turbine from operating and ambient measurements.
Target: carbon_monoxide
Target unit: mg/m^3
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing or an invalid measurement replaced with missing.
Field definitions and context: AT: ambient Celsius; AP: ambient mbar; AH: percent humidity; AFDP: filter differential pressure mbar; GTEP: exhaust pressure mbar; TIT/TAT: inlet/after-turbine Celsius; CDP: compressor discharge pressure mbar; TEY: source hourly energy yield in MWh. Both pollutant target columns are excluded from input. Measurements are contemporaneous.
Input JSON: {"AT":4.5878,"AP":1018.7,"AH":83.675,"AFDP":3.5758,"GTEP":23.979,"TIT":1086.2,"TAT":549.83,"TEY":134.67,"CDP":11.898}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
